title: Chestnut

Description

The Chestnut tree is one of the various trees that can be found in Finlay. It is a large, dark brown tree with chestnut shells in the leaves. Some of the larger variants also have burl twisting around the trunk. It seems to be the largest type of tree in the game.

Like every other material in-game, it can be used to complete schematics.

Putting the tree into a material gun reveals there are 3 separate versions of it. All of them share the same textures.

The small version that generates without burls sells for significantly more per unit. This is likely to prevent people from gaining massive amounts of money by selling one tree.
